annotations.title: Send a test message to an alert target

description: Queues a signed test message (event "test") to one delivery target, or to every target of one of your key's own rules, and waits a few seconds for the result: status sent, retry or dead with the HTTP status or error. A target can be tested a few times every 10 minutes. Needs an API key.

ruleId.description: Or: test every target of this rule.

targetId.description: The delivery target to test (from `list_alerts` or the `webhook` block of `create_alert`).

name: test_alert
title: Send a test message to an alert target
